newsitem.title: USA: Resort Income gets $1.8 mln from sale.
newsitem.headline: Resort Income gets $1.8 mln from sale.

text.p: Resort Income Investors Inc said Wednesday it received about $1.8 million in proceeds for the sale of the 28-acre site on the island of Saint Maarten in the Netherlands Antilles, which reserved the company's loan to RCH Investments Llc.
The proceeds were sufficient to retire RCH's obligaiton to a lender senior to Resort Income Investors, the company said.
As a condition of the sale, the company released liens it had against the property and maintains no interest in the property.

The company said negotiations continue between management and the company's affiliated borrowers in an effort to maximize recovery on each of its remaining loans. Mangement is hopeful negotiations will be concluded by the end of the quarter, the company said.

The company also said that as the result of uncertainty caused by various lawsuits, no peridoic liquidating distributions will currently be made to stockholders. Management will continue to review this decision, the company said.
